arguments.command:
$ref="E:\项目_手动重构\build\final-hone-dh1b_5mf\project\workspace\cooperation\8e577bfc8472\artifacts\refcheck"
$main="E:\项目_手动重构\build\final-hone-dh1b_5mf\project\workspace\cooperation\8e577bfc8472\main"
foreach($d in 'docs','data_file','examples'){ Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $main $d) -Destination $ref -Recurse -Force }
Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $main 'INPUTS.md') -Destination $ref -Force
Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $main 'scripts') -Destination $ref -Recurse -Force
Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $main 'hone\__main__.py') -Destination (Join-Path $ref 'hone\__main__.py') -Force
# empty tests package so unittest discover is well-defined
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $ref 'tests') | Out-Null
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ref 'tests\__init__.py') -Value '' -Encoding utf8
$env:PYTHONPATH=$ref
python (Join-Path $ref 'scripts\verify_acceptance.py') --quick
arguments.description: Run acceptance harness against reference implementation
